Stage1: Closed on documented evidence-limited result; BPI-G3 selects BP-R
Stage2: Claim/direction approved; protocol ready; substantive execution not started
next_allowed_action: Open bounded BP-R admission audit to BPR-G2 or BPR-G3

BPR-G0.question: Adopt the relative representation/control-response claim?
BPR-G0.status: Closed by current approval; preserves BP-I's scoped result

BPR-G1.question: Which scope, fairness, accounting and evidence limits govern admission?
BPR-G1.status: Closed for opening; no new physical law adopted

BPR-E1.question: Does the source family support genuine common-rate leverage under complete accounting?

BPR-E2.question: What richer state/projection and strongest compact/memory rivals are justified?
BPR-E2.status: Depends on E1 task qualification; no scientific adoption by reading

BPR-E3.question: What intervention-response distinction survives those rivals, and what remains missing?
BPR-E3.status: Depends on E1/E2; cannot infer useful gradients from forward differences

BPR-G2.question: Adopt a concrete traffic/actuator/information/reference or acceptance amendment?
BPR-G2.status: Trigger only if a named transfer requires changing methodological meaning

BPR-G3.question: Accept admission disposition and select the next stage?
BPR-G3.status: End-stage gate after E1–E3 and any triggered G2

manual_consistency_audit: Claim change explicit; original information findings preserved
No repeated approval required for accepted direction and transcribed boundaries
Rate/TST task admission and strong reduction questions belong to evidence work
Missing operational history not assumed solved or unavailable
Common information/projection/forcing and stronger memory rivals required
Source reading default distinguished from physical-law adoption
G2 reserved for concrete scientific transfer; G3 for end-stage disposition
No Stage2 execution, later-stage opening or experiment authorized by readiness question
Historical reports/checks remain pre-acceptance snapshots; closure supersedes status labels
scope: Review documentation only; no production or feedback edits
